**Opening Frame Prompt:**  
A young boy walks joyfully through a vast field of dandelions, holding one in his hand as its seeds scatter into the air. The camera begins with a low-angle shot, focusing on his red sneakers stepping through the lush green grass, then smoothly tilts upward to capture his carefree posture and the vibrant rocket design on his blue shirt. The golden dandelion field stretches endlessly under a bright blue sky dotted with fluffy white clouds. A soft breeze animates the flowers and seeds as the sunlight casts a warm, diffused glow across the scene. Cinematic style with a dreamy, whimsical tone, shot on a 35mm lens at f/2.8 for a shallow depth of field.  

**Closing Frame Prompt:**  
The boy stands still, facing the horizon as dandelion seeds float around him in slow motion, illuminated by the golden hour light. The camera takes a wide-angle shot, framing the expansive rolling hills and the serene landscape behind him, with the sun dipping low in the sky. His silhouette is softly outlined by the warm light, and his outstretched hand releases the final seeds into the wind. The motion transitions into a gentle crane shot, pulling upward and outward to reveal the full majesty of the glowing field and distant hills. Shot on an 85mm lens at f/4 for balanced focus, with a poetic and nostalgic cinematic style.
